notes: A colossal flat-sided wooden box vessel of pitch-blackened plank (gopher-wood, pitched within and without — Gen 6:14), with a long low pitched gable roof. Exactly ONE square doorway set in the long flat side, standing open; no second door (Gen 6:16). Reads as a vast box-like ark, not a small boat, curved/pointed sailing hull, shed or house (Gen 6:15). All facts honored.
